Subject: Evaluation kickoff sequencing and security handoff — MedCura trial

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the kickoff: 

- Primary goal: reduce triage time for clinical documentation review and auto-suggest coding labels; target a 40–60% reduction in manual review for the initial pilot.
- Key success metrics you mentioned: inference latency under 350ms p95 for single-request flows, >=85% precision on label suggestions in the prompt set, and clear data residency / logging controls.
- Must-haves for trial: VPC/private deployment option, token-level audit logs, and an agreed prompt/eval pack to validate regressions.

Next step: schedule the evaluation kickoff (demo + technical deep dive + trial plan review). Can you confirm which of these windows works on your side? I propose: 

1) Tue Oct 5 — 11:00 AM ET / 08:00 AM PT 
2) Wed Oct 6 — 2:00 PM ET / 11:00 AM PT 
3) Thu Oct 7 — 10:00 AM ET / 07:00 AM PT

We’ll bring a solutions engineer and the technical owner (Karthik) to cover integration and the trial runbook. I’ve attached a short trial-plan-outline to give you a sense of the timeline and artifacts we’ll review.

Two quick asks before kickoff: 
- Please confirm the security/compliance contact who should receive our SOC2 questionnaire (we can route to your security or procurement).
- If possible, share 50–200 de-identified sample records we can use to generate an initial prompt set and warm the model before the controlled trial.

If none of the windows work, reply with 2x alternatives and we’ll adapt. I’ll hold the Oct 5 slot tentatively until EOD PT tomorrow.

Attachments: trial-plan-outline.pdf (high-level timeline + roles)

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0116

Emma / team — quick technical note ahead of the kickoff: 

- For the pilot we recommend a small controlled run: 150–250 de-identified records, a dedicated KV-cache warmup pass, and two prompt templates to validate both single-shot suggestion quality and a short multi-turn clarification flow.
- Recommended inference config for parity testing: batch size = 8 (to balance throughput/latency), max tokens = 256, and a 5-minute KV cache retention during interactive sessions.
- If you have throughput targets, please share requests-per-second estimates (p50/p95) so I can size the Dedicated pool and estimate cost impact for the trial.

I’ll prepare a one-page runbook to walk through the exact steps we’ll perform during the trial sandbox.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
